import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # remove exact duplicate rows (penguin_id should be unique)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # fix island label variants (extra spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df.loc[~df['island'].isin(['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen']), 'island'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g stored as text with commas -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # out-of-range body masses (e.g. 3625000 g) are invalid -> set to NaN
    bad = (df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500)
    df.loc[bad, 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['island'])
    counts = d.groupby('island').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
